cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias && echo "=== COLLECT PROCESSES ===" && ps aux | grep collect | grep -v grep && echo "---" || echo "NO COLLECT PROCESSES"

echo "=== VLLM PROCESSES ===" && ps aux | grep vllm | grep -v grep || echo "NO VLLM PROCESSES"

echo "=== EXP-017 PID ===" && ps -p 318082 -o pid,etime,cmd 2>/dev/null || echo "PID 318082 NOT FOUND"

echo "=== API JUDGE DATA ===" 
cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001 2>/dev/null || cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias
for d in output_n17_*proxy*/; do
  name=$(basename "$d")
  jsonl=$(ls "$d"/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$jsonl" ]; then
    lines=$(wc -l < "$jsonl")
    echo "$name: $lines / 18000"
  else
    echo "$name: NO JSONL"
  fi
done 2>/dev/null

echo "=== LOCAL JUDGE DATA ==="
for d in output_n17_llama* output_n17_qwen2.5*; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    name=$(basename "$d")
    jsonl=$(ls "$d"/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$jsonl" ]; then
      lines=$(wc -l < "$jsonl")
      echo "$name: $lines / 18000"
    else
      echo "$name: NO JSONL"
    fi
  fi
done 2>/dev/null

echo "=== ALL N17 JSONL FILES ==="
find /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias -path "*n17*/*.jsonl" -exec sh -c 'echo "{}: $(wc -l < "{}")"' \; 2>/dev/null

echo "=== RESULTS DIR ==="
ls -la /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/results/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no results dir"
find /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/results -name "*.jsonl" -exec sh -c 'echo "{}: $(wc -l < "{}")"' \; 2>/dev/null
